name: Intruder Alarm
oracle_text:
Creatures don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
Whenever a creature enters, untap all creatures.
blocked_sentences: Creatures don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.

needs.what: A static continuous effect, readable at the untap step, that stops every permanent matching a printed-characteristic filter (here: Creature, ANY controller -- both players, and creatures that enter after this enchantment) from untapping during its controller's untap step, for as long as the source is on the battlefield -- the Intruder Alarm / Back to Basics / Winter Orb shape. The filter must reach an opponent's creatures too, so the effect cannot be scoped to the source's controller.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has no untap prohibition at all: untap_during_each_untap_step is the opposite (it adds untaps), and freeze_opponent_lands is Vorinclex's tap-for-mana rider on lands only, applied one-shot at the moment an opponent taps a land for mana. The two untap holds the untap step consults are both per-object and applied by an op at resolution: skip_next_untap (the skip_untap op) is spent by a single untap step, and frozen_by (the freeze op) locks only the objects chosen when that effect resolved, so creatures that enter on later turns -- exactly the ones this card's own second ability keeps making relevant -- would never be caught. A permanent's static ability cannot run an op, and there is no trigger event for 'a player's untap step begins' to hang one on. Without it the card is inverted -- the second printed line alone is a pure-upside untap engine with none of the drawback -- which is why no partial answer was written.
